In mathematics, the '''Duistermaat–Heckman formula''', due to {{harvs |txt |authorlink=Johannes Jisse Duistermaat |last=Duistermaat |last2=Heckman |year=1982}}, states that the 
pushforward of the canonical ([[Liouville measure|Liouville]]) measure on a [[symplectic manifold]] under the [[moment map]] is a piecewise polynomial measure. Equivalently, the [[Fourier transform]] of the canonical measure is given ''exactly'' by the [[stationary phase approximation]].

{{harvtxt|Berline|Vergne|1982}} and, independently,  {{harvtxt|Atiyah|Bott|1984}} showed how to deduce the Duistermaat–Heckman formula from a [[Localization formula for equivariant cohomology|localization theorem]] for [[equivariant cohomology]].
